name: cosmic-orb
title: Cosmic Orb
description: An iridescent soap-bubble planet on the brand ground: a slowly spinning sphere of nebula bands, dust lanes and twinkling stars wrapped in a refracting glass limb with chromatic aberration at the edge; keeps its own nebula colours. Hues, spin, glow, size, beat pulse and cues are variables; holds 30 s or fades.
